about.title: Transforming ideas into <0>scalable solutions</0>
about.paragraph1: I am a Full Stack Software Engineer with a technical background in Web and Mobile, currently pursuing a degree in Software Engineering. I have experience in web and mobile app development, system architecture, RESTful APIs, databases, and technology integration to build robust and scalable solutions.
about.paragraph2: I also act in technical project and team leadership, applying architecture best practices, Design Patterns, Git, CI/CD, and agile methodologies. I have experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Tauri, automation with n8n, and external API and service integrations.
about.paragraph3: My work focuses on solving real-world problems and delivering measurable impact, from commercial process automation to ERP system development. I also have experience applying AI to workflow automation and process optimization.
